decisions.reason: The general standard that model figures be logical and credible does not change the existing rules for documenting assumptions, selecting sources, or handling unavailable inputs.
The source adds an output-quality standard but does not change the candidate's data-verification requirement or hierarchy of reference sources.
The source does not revise the approved OPEX range, its source, or the exclusion of the incomplete appendix amount.
The general credibility instruction does not alter the required Canadian CCA method, asset-class examples, or modeled tax effects.
The source does not change the CAPEX estimate, midpoint assumption basis, or treatment of shared program costs.
The source does not revise the 70/30 structure, financing rate, single-tranche approach, mezzanine treatment, or refinement trigger.
The source does not alter the eight-site configuration, Business Case site-list source, or method for modeling unavailable site-level details.
The funding scenarios and required viability finding remain unchanged; the broad credibility standard is already owned by the source Requirement and does not add a distinct scenario rule.
The source does not modify the required three-statement structure or the basis for rebuilding the financial engine.
The source does not change the model currency or 2026 price base year.
The source does not change the modeled revenue streams, pricing-assumption basis, or revenue-assumption documentation requirement.
The source does not add, remove, or revise any sensitivity-analysis variable.
